description: Revvity, Inc. is a leading provider of health science solutions, technologies, expertise and services that deliver complete workflows from discovery to development, and from diagnosis to cure, and describes itself as revolutionizing what's possible in healthcare, with specialized focus areas in translational multi-omics technologies, biomarker identification, imaging, prediction, screening, detection and diagnosis, informatics and more. Its headquarters are in Waltham, Massachusetts, and it markets its products and services in more than 160 countries, and as of December 28, 2025 it employed approximately 11,000 employees, with its common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol RVTY and the company a component of the S&P 500 Index. Its products and services include reagents, including radiometric detection solutions with over 750 radiochemicals for use with liquid and plate-based analyzers utilized in research, environmental and drug discovery applications, and reagents and solutions for microscopy and imaging applications, including PhenoVue cellular imaging reagents and cell painting kits, PhenoPlate cellular imaging microplates, GrowDex hydrogels, fluorophore-conjugated and enzyme-conjugated antibodies, and buffers and solutions such as its Ce3D collection for 3D tissue imaging.
